# Employment Agreement

Between Example Ltd ("the Company") and the Employee named in the offer letter.
Synthetic test fixture; every name and figure is invented.

1. Position. The Employee is employed as Data Analyst, reporting to the Head of Analytics.
2. Working time. The regular working time is 40 hours per week.
3. Salary. The annual base salary is 54,000, paid monthly.
4. Vacation. The Employee receives 25 working days of paid vacation per calendar year.
5. Bonus. A bonus of 3,000 is paid each March.
6. Relocation. If the Employee leaves within 12 months of the start date, the Employee repays relocation costs of up to two months of the salary stated in section 3.
7. Notice. After probation, either party may end this agreement with 4 weeks' notice.
8. Probation. The first 6 months are a probation period, during which either party may end this agreement with 2 weeks' notice.
9. Handbook. The Company Handbook forms part of this agreement.
10. Entire agreement. This agreement and the documents it names are the entire agreement between the parties.

## Annex A

- Weekly working time: 40 hours.
- Vacation: 25 working days per calendar year.
- Annual gross pay: 54,000.
